recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的纖維化間質中，可見大型、深染、核質比高的腫瘤細胞成巢並沿纖維隔排列，形態上與周圍造血細胞不同、具黏聚性，提示非造血性的轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤（此例為肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Nests and cords of medium-to-large tumor cells with high N:C ratio set in pink fibrotic stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula
Hyperchromatic round to oval, sometimes molded or elongated nuclei with coarse chromatin
Scant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm; cells cohesive with focal discohesion within spaces vaguely resembling alveolar spaces
Spindled fibroblast-like cells and collagen forming septa between tumor islands
Scattered red cells; residual normal hematopoiesis not evident in this field
describe_en: High-power view of a hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows a fibrotic stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by islands and cords of cohesive, medium-to-large tumor cells. The cells have hyperchromatic round to oval nuclei with coarse chromatin and scant amphophilic cytoplasm, and are separated by collagenous septa with focal loss of cohesion in the center of nests. Normal hematopoietic elements are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic small round blue cell tumor; immunohistochemistry (desmin, myogenin) supports metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma may form rosettes with neuropil and is synaptophysin/PHOX2B positive and myogenin negative.
Ewing cells are more uniform with fine chromatin and clear glycogen-rich cytoplasm, and are CD99/NKX2.2 positive and myogenin negative.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive and diffusely infiltrative rather than nested in fibrous septa, and express TdT with lineage markers.
Megakaryoblasts in fibrotic marrow can cluster, but express CD61/CD42b and are negative for desmin and myogenin.
